results.name: iFinD Fund Analysis
results.description:
Query NAV snapshots and static profiles for China public mutual funds.
- query_type='nav': Retrieve fund NAV on a specific date, including unit NAV, cumulative NAV, NAV growth rate, and subscription/redemption status. Requires codes (.OF format) and date.
- query_type='info': Retrieve static fund profile including fund type, inception date, current manager, custodian, management/custody fee rates, and performance benchmark. Requires codes (.OF format) only; date is ignored.
Fund codes must use the .OF suffix, e.g. '110011.OF,000001.OF'.

params.name: codes
params.description: Fund codes, comma-separated, must use .OF suffix, e.g. '110011.OF,000001.OF' (max 50)

params.name: date
params.description: Query date in YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD format. Required for query_type='nav'; ignored for query_type='info'.
